label: test $ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_method_name
command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat test --tests "$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_method_name" } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew test --tests "$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_method_name" } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn test -Dtest="$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name#$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_method_name" } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }

label: test $ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name
command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat test --tests "$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name" } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew test --tests "$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name" } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn test -Dtest="$ZED_CUSTOM_kotlin_class_name" } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }

label: run main
command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat run --console=plain } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew run --console=plain } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn compile exec:java } elseif (Get-Command kotlin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & kotlin "$ZED_FILE" } else { Write-Error 'No Kotlin runtime found' }

label: run all tests
command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat test } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew test } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn test } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }
